```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```
#data cleaning
```{r}

## combine screen data with gene expression data

Selected_genes_for_follow_up <-read.csv("Selected_genes_for_follow_up_2.csv") %>% dplyr::select(1:6)
target_lines_transcriptome_data <- read.csv("~/Documents/Data/current_projects/symphony/paper_writing/sym_101/sym_101_design/input/target_lines_transcriptome_data.csv", header=TRUE)
Model <- read.csv("~/Documents/Data/current_projects/symphony/paper_writing/sym_101/sym_101_design/input/Model.csv", header = TRUE)
OmicsProfiles <- read.csv("~/Documents/Data/current_projects/symphony/paper_writing/sym_101/sym_101_design/input/OmicsProfiles.csv", header = TRUE)


Selected_genes_for_follow_up <- Selected_genes_for_follow_up %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_label = if (n() == 1) Gene else paste0(Gene, "_TR", row_number())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Selected_genes_for_follow_up<-Selected_genes_for_follow_up %>% reshape2::melt(id.vars=c("Gene", "Transcript_ID","transcript_biotype", "gene_label")) %>% dplyr::rename(Cell_Line=variable, Cas13d_score=value)



Selected_genes_for_follow_up$Cell_Line <- gsub("_Cas13_LFC", "", Selected_genes_for_follow_up$Cell_Line)
Selected_genes_for_follow_up$Cell_Line <- gsub("H1299", "NCIH1299", Selected_genes_for_follow_up$Cell_Line)
Selected_genes_for_follow_up$Cell_Line <- gsub("H1975", "NCIH1975", Selected_genes_for_follow_up$Cell_Line)

target_lines<- left_join((Model %>% filter(StrippedCellLineName %in% c("A549", "NCIH1299", "NCIH1975")) %>% select(StrippedCellLineName,ModelID)), (OmicsProfiles %>% filter(Datatype=="rna")), by="ModelID")
target_lines$ProfileID <- gsub("-", ".", target_lines$ProfileID)


x3_lines_transcriptome<- target_lines_transcriptome_data %>% select(Data_name, target_lines$ProfileID)

x3_lines_transcriptome<- x3_lines_transcriptome %>% dplyr::rename(
  NCIH1299=PR.Er9ReY,

NCIH1975=PR.dmYRK0,
A549=PR.Em6pVT) %>% reshape2::melt() %>% dplyr::rename(Cell_Line=variable, transcript_expresiion=value)

x3_lines_transcriptome <- x3_lines_transcriptome %>%
  mutate(Data_name = gsub("[()]", "", Data_name)) %>%
  separate(Data_name, into = c("Gene", "Transcript_ID"), sep = "_")

follow_up_genes_tr_data<- (left_join(Selected_genes_for_follow_up, x3_lines_transcriptome, by=c("Gene", "Transcript_ID", "Cell_Line") ))


follow_up_genes_tr_data[is.na(follow_up_genes_tr_data)] <- 0

mean_expression<- follow_up_genes_tr_data %>% filter(transcript_biotype=="LncRNA") %>% group_by(Cell_Line,Gene, Transcript_ID) %>% 

summarise(mean_expression=mean(transcript_expresiion))


```
# Plotting
```{r}

library(forcats)
library("ggnewscale")


# Step 1: Arrange the data frame by transcript expression
df <- follow_up_genes_tr_data %>%
  arrange(transcript_expresiion)

# Step 2: Set gene_label as a factor with levels in arranged order
df$gene_label <- factor(df$gene_label, levels = unique(df$gene_label))

# Now plot as before
p_main <-ggplot(df, aes(x = Cell_Line, y = gene_label)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -Cas13d_score, color = transcript_expresiion)) +
  scale_color_gradient(high = "red", low = "blue",
                        name = "Gene Expression\n(Log2(TPM+1) )") +
  scale_size( name = "Cas13d Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Cell Line", y = "Gene") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        text=element_text(size=6), axis.title = element_blank())

p_main



# Strip plot for gene biotype
p_strip <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = gene_label, fill = transcript_biotype)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Gene Biotype") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    text=element_text(size=6)
  )



# Combine with cowplot or patchwork

library(patchwork)

# Side-by-side: biotype strip + main dot plot
plot<- p_strip + p_main + plot_layout(widths = c(0.05, 1))+ggtitle("Follow-up Genes\nGene Expression and Cas13d Score")

plot
library(svglite)

ggsave(filename = "follow_up_genes_data.svg", width = 15, height = 15,unit="cm", dpi=1000)

```
